> LLM-generated review from https://github.com/canonical/maas-code-reviewer.
> Intended to assist a human reviewer, not replace one — suggestions may be
> incorrect, please verify before acting.


Docs-only link refresh; five of six changes verified live. One regression: the iptables link in docs/reference/configuration-guides/logging.md now points at https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo, which returns HTTP 404 (fetched directly; the old help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo URL now 302s to that same 404, so the page is gone, not moved). Pick a live target instead.

Verified working: https://docs.cloud-init.io/ (serves cloud-init 26.2 docs), https://canonical.com/multipass, https://ubuntu.com/enterprise-store/docs/ (documentation.ubuntu.com/enterprise-store redirects here, so the change follows the actual redirect), and docs/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md exists, so the root-relative link in deploy-dpus.md resolves and matches the dominant repo convention (e.g. decommission-maas.md:27, index.md:20).

Not in this diff but the same class of breakage, worth folding in: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus-without-bmc.md:18 still links to https://maas.io/docs/how-to-work-with-tags, which redirects to canonical.com/maas/docs/stable/how-to-guides/work-with-tags/ and 404s; the in-repo equivalent is /how-to-guides/manage-machine-groups.md#manage-tags-in-maas. docs/uncategorized/join-our-forum.md:3 embeds a dead maas.io/docs URL as a Google Form prefill value (cosmetic only).

Note `linkcheck_ignore` in docs/conf.py is nearly empty, so `make linkcheck` would have caught the 404 above — running it on this branch is the cheap verification for this kind of PR.

docs/reference/configuration-guides/logg.16: Broken: https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo returns HTTP 404 (verified by fetch). The legacy help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo now redirects to this same 404, so the page was dropped in the wiki migration rather than relocated. Replace with a live target, e.g. https://documentation.ubuntu.com/server/how-to/security/firewalls/ (covers both iptables and ufw) or the upstream https://www.netfilter.org/documentation/HOWTO/packet-filtering-HOWTO.html. The UFW link on this line is fine — wiki.ubuntu.com/UncomplicatedFirewall redirects to the live UFW_development page.

docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md.425: Target and style are right (root-relative .md matches the convention used across how-to-guides). Two nits while you're here: the link text still reads like an external reference — "MAAS Documentation \- How to Manage Machines" — and carries an escaped hyphen that only existed for the old external title; `[Manage machines](/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md)` is clearer. Also this line lost its trailing two spaces while siblings 426-428 keep theirs; harmless inside a list, but normalize all four for consistency.
